description: This multi-level pie chart represents a hierarchical categorization of medical ethics principles, consisting of an inner circle with four main categories and an outer ring containing twenty-six corresponding subcategories, totaling thirty distinct segments. The inner circle is divided into four colored slices: "Beneficence" in bright blue, which is the largest segment occupying approximately 45% of the chart; "Autonomy" in green, taking up roughly 25%; "Justice" in orange, accounting for about 15%; and "Non-Maleficence" in purple, representing approximately 15%. The outer ring subdivides these main principles into specific guidelines, color-coded in lighter shades of their parent category's color. The blue "Beneficence" section is split into eleven light blue outer slices labeled "Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation," "Comply with Laws and Regulations," "Provide Medical Care to Patients," "Continual Learning," "Provide Assistance in Emergency," "Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues," "Respect Life, Dignity of Patients," "Give Top Priority to Patient's Interest in Conflict of Interests," "Minimizing Conflicts of Interest," "Ethical research," and "Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees." The green "Autonomy" section is divided into seven light green slices labeled "Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient," "Respect Patient's Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice," "Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication," "Keep Confidential of Patient's Information," "Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives," "Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement," and "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve." The purple "Non-Maleficence" section contains four light purple slices labeled "Prevent Patient from Harm," "Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care," "Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct," and "Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain." The orange "Justice" section is split into four light orange slices labeled "Promote the Health of Community and Public Education," "Promote Environmental Sustainability," "Allocate Medical Sources Fairly," and "Treat Patients Fairly and Equally." The chart does not include a separate legend or numerical percentage labels, as all text is placed directly within the segments. The labels in the inner circle are visually emphasized with larger text, while the outer ring labels are smaller and rotated to fit within their respective slices. The segments are not ordered by size in a specific descending or ascending sequence around the circle, though the outer subcategories appear roughly equal in proportion within their respective parent sections.
